additional_info.subject: ID0379073-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / S3 170003435] Missing Converters in DC1,4 CRM:00315001762
additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S3 170003435
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
0Ea2no
Problem Description
: Missing 1 converter in DC1 and 1 converter in DC4
Troubleshooting
:
After performing several converter groupings, I was only able to notice in the first attempt the Voltage raise in the missing converters but no allocation. I performed 5 more times and these other 5 times, the converters don't seem to be allocated and as such they don't get the Voltage raise.
As such I believe there might be something wrong in the CAN line for the converters that don't have this Serial Number. Is it possible to send the technician just to make a visual inspection? Try plugging out and plugging back in, otherwise we will need to check the line or possibly swap one of these converters with the neighbour to be 100% sure that the CAN cables are the root cause.
If by swapping the converters, the converters are now noticed in the network, then the CAN cables should need to be replaced.
What is your opinion?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0379073
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
